description: Chord (getchord.xyz) on-chain market data, best-route swap quotes and UNSIGNED swap transactions on eight EVM chains: Monad, Robinhood Chain (tokenized US stocks such as NVDA, TSLA, SPY traded against USDG), Arc (Circle's chain, USDC as gas), Avalanche, Base, BNB Chain, Arbitrum One and Ethereum. Use when the user asks for a token price or chart, the most traded or trending tokens, chain or DEX volume, a swap quote or route, an unsigned swap for their own wallet to sign, a Robinhood Chain stock token and its gap to the real share, holders, smart-money wallets, a wallet's PnL, or liquidity pools on these chains. Also Solana data: pump.fun / PumpSwap / Meteora / Raydium / Orca token boards, prices, candles, traders and wallet PnL (Solana swaps are in beta, not open to API keys yet). Do NOT use for other chains (Optimism, Polygon, TRON...), exchange accounts, perps or limit orders, transfers, withdrawals or bridging, or general blockchain education. Chord never signs or moves funds.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent validate API outcomes instead of assuming success?
Did the agent preserve evidence for request/response behavior and error handling?
